title: Merchant internal process events
description: Event stream emitted by a merchant seller (restaurant, retail, service merchant, etc.) to coordinate with buyer and courier. The event log is the SSoT for the merchant's role in the order lifecycle. Generic across local-commerce verticals; the event vocabulary maps to the merchant's order-fulfillment flow.

fields.name: evidenceUri
fields.description: Optional reference to off-chain evidence (e.g., photo of meal, ticket scan, packing slip).
